The Program Factory

We manufacture insurance programs.

We do not just sell insurance. We engineer and build the businesses that write it, one niche program at a time.

How the line works
From idea to profitable program, engineered from the underwriter outward.
+
Every program starts with a custom request and a proven underwriter, not a product we are trying to sell. From there it runs the line: recruit the team, design the program around their appetite, bring in the capital, underwrite, actuarial, match to capacity, wire up the technology, launch, and often, sell. Each program is branded on its own and built clean, so it can stand alone, or be sold.
TeleMac, our AI
Proprietary technology we build in-house.
+
TeleMac is our own AI and underwriting technology, built to analyze, price, and place risk faster than a traditional shop can, and to run every program with the reporting and data visibility that institutional capacity partners require. It is the engine underneath the factory.
Built to order
Tell us the class you want written. We go build it.
+
Rather than pushing products, we source what capacity partners actually want. Name a class, and we go find the underwriter who has mastered it, the book that proves the market, and the distribution that scales it, then wrap it in the right paper and platform. The weirder the risk, the better.
Growth strategy

My job is to get everyone in one room.

Specialty underwriters, the capital to back them, and the capacity to write them. Three groups that rarely sit at the same table. I bring them together, then I build the systems, platforms, and program timelines that keep them moving.

Specialty underwritersThe niche experts other markets can't find or keep.Our recruitment arm brings them
CapitalInvestors who want insurance in their portfolio, and a clean way in.You bring it
CapacityThe carrier and reinsurance markets that let a program actually write.My 35+ year team brings it
Then I close the door.I connect the three, and TeleMac wires the platform, the back-end AI, and the program timelines underneath. That is how a program goes from a name on a page to written premium.
Why insurance

The best business most portfolios are missing.

Insurance earns while it holds the risk, and its returns barely move with the stock market. Recurring income plus real diversification is a rare combination. Specialty is where it pays best.

Uncorrelated to the market
A real diversifier, not another tech bet.
+
Underwriting profit comes from pricing risk correctly, not from the market going up. When equities swing, insurance risk mostly does not follow. That makes it one of the few return streams that genuinely diversifies a portfolio.
You earn while you hold it
The float engine.
+
Premium comes in before claims go out. That float is capital you put to work in the meantime. It is the quiet engine behind some of the best compounding track records in all of finance.
Specialty is the sweet spot
Where the margin actually lives.
+
Excess and surplus lines are the fastest-growing, best-priced corner of the market, and they have grown double digits for years. Niche programs run by real underwriters are where the underwriting margin sits, not in commodity lines.
Capital-light, high-multiple
Recurring revenue that can be sold.
+
MGAs and distribution earn commission and profit share without carrying the balance sheet. Recurring, capital-light revenue is exactly what trades at premium multiples, and exactly what a buyer wants.

The thesis
A repeatable model, not a one-off.
+
We find the best niche underwriters in the market, recruit them with the right equity and infrastructure, and build purpose-fit programs around their expertise, their books, and their distribution. We bring the platform. They bring the talent. Together we give capacity partners exactly what they want to write, and nothing they don't. That is repeatable, and it compounds.
Why now
The talent is moving, and we're where it lands.
+
Specialty and excess and surplus is the fastest-moving, best-performing corner of insurance, and the best underwriters are mobile. When a carrier stops listening, the underwriter moves, and the book moves with them. We are the home they move to. A window like this does not sit still.
How it makes money
Commission and profit share, on shared rails.
+
Each program is a branded MGA that earns commission and profit share on the business it writes, run on shared infrastructure so every new program launches leaner than the last. Underwriters hold equity in what they build. Recurring revenue, real operating leverage, aligned incentives.
The bench
Not a first-timer's cap table.
+
Property and inland-marine underwriting leadership with 35+ years on the desk, a track record of reducing loss ratios while growing written premium at several major carriers and MGAs. P&C relationships since 1994 across underwriting, broking, and distribution. And a capital-and-systems partner out of international business development and private equity. Depth on day one.
What we've already built
Past the idea stage.
+
Proprietary AI in production, not a slide. A pipeline of programs, some launch-ready, some in design. A growing carrier and market network. A multi-state licensing footprint filling in. Real infrastructure, already running.
Built to sell
Clean by design.
+
Every program is branded on its own and built clean: its own entity, its own clean delegated authority, its own equity. Each one can stand alone, scale, or be sold. We are building toward real exits, on purpose.
